$comment: Kenney's 1-Bit sheets are effectively two-tone. Most cells are best handled with a layer-level 'tint' in the manifest, which forces every opaque pixel to one palette token. Use this table only for sheets with more than one meaningful source color.
$note: Tokens beginning with @ are THEME KEYS — they bake as reserved key colors and get swapped per room at draw time. See docs/05-ASSETS.md.
